description: Fetch a complete instruction file from the OpenClaw registry by slug. Returns the full Markdown file including YAML frontmatter, purpose, usage notes, and the deployable instruction text. The instruction is in the "## The Instruction" section.

instruction_only.description: If true, return only the deployable instruction text (extracted from the fenced code block). If false, return the full Markdown file. Default: false.

slug.description: The slug of the instruction file (e.g. "tier1-customer-support", "structured-web-research"). Get slugs from search_registry.

name: get_instruction
